outlook.statement: Expansion aligned with Company's long-term growth strategy and is expected to improve operational performance, support rising customer demand, and reinforce its competitive position in the market.

India's GDP growth expected to moderate to 6.4%-6.8% in FY 2026-27 from 7.7% in FY 2025-26, driven by elevated crude oil prices and geopolitical friction, but supported by strong domestic consumption, credit expansion, and public capex.
Global masterbatch market projected to grow from USD 7.0 billion in 2025 to USD 7.4 billion in 2026 and USD 10.5 billion by 2033 at ~5% CAGR, with Asia Pacific as largest and fastest-growing region.
Company continues to monitor geopolitical situation closely for its bearing on input costs and export demand in the current year.

Medium-term backdrop remains constructive; priorities for FY2026-27: (i) protect margins through disciplined feedstock procurement, inventory planning and vendor diversification; (ii) deepen regulatory compliance capability; (iii) leverage scaled R&D and sample development capacity; (iv) evaluate new growth avenues including recycled-content masterbatches, rPET-based products, and dope-dyeing solutions.

Company approaches future with measured optimism; has strengthened fundamental levers — investing in R&D and innovation, expanding manufacturing capabilities, improving operational efficiencies, building large sustainable energy infrastructure, strengthening people and leadership capabilities, and deepening focus on customers and new markets.
